items.title: GTA 6: Hacks, leaks, delays and the long road to release | BBC News
items.description:
Love may be a long road, but so has the road to release for Grand Theft Auto VI.
 
BBC News's Mel Ramsay leads us through the highs and lows of Grand Theft Auto VI's production, while BBC Tech Now's Laura Cress looks at the impact of hacks, leaks and the controversy surrounding pre-orders.
 
Meanwhile, BBC Newsbeat's Tom Richardson looks at the ongoing tribunal between dismissed Rockstar North employees and what the future could look like for workers at one of the UK's biggest names in gaming.
